item.title: Kossetsu Shita Sunao Cool na Kanojo no Sewa o Suru Hanashi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tamashiro
  • 発売日: 2009-11-20
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 骨折した素直クールな彼女の世話をする話
  • 英語名: Kossetsu Shita Sunao Cool na Kanojo no Sewa o Suru Hanashi

あらすじ

“Until this long holiday ends, I’ll take care of everything for you!”

A classmate suffers a severe injury, breaking her arms and legs…

And the protagonist ends up taking care of her.

Despite her straightforward and cool demeanor, she makes some embarrassing and outrageous requests,

which (using all of his self-control) he fulfills!

item.title: Tra x uma ~Hontou ni Atta Itai Hanashi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tamashiro
  • 発売日: 2009-04-28
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: とら×うま ～本当にあった痛い話～
  • 英語名: Tra x uma Hontou ni Atta Itai Hanashi

あらすじ

It is summer break, and Kotarou has devoted himself to jerking off in the mostly vacant school dormitory.

But then he feels someone’s eyes on him. He turns to see that his door is slightly ajar.

Turns out that Yukie, the daughter of the dorm manager was still there!
